I'm preeettty sure that's just because it's relying on the separate WebView app, using WebView is also how it's possible for people to make sub-megabyte android browsers, such as [Naked Browser](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fevdev.nakedbrowser) and [Via](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=mark.via.gp&hl=en)
